"""Reuse saved component geometry to explain an attributed false Foam front.

No detector/decoder, new mask, selection rule, threshold or truth propagation.
Adapted from s11-local-foam-structure-context-001/run.py.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, sys
import cv2
import numpy as np
root=Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(root));sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'src'))
from tests.diagnostics.s11_foam_support_geometry import measure
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision import foam_front_detector as owner
out=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
load=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text())
prior=root/'sample/output/s11-local-xy-implementation-20261009-001'
folder=prior/'v2-sample4-scoped-FULL'
record_path=root/'docs/50-diagnostics/s11/2026-10-09-local-xy-sequence-causality.json'
record=load(record_path);pre=load(prior/'preflight-v2.json')
source_pins={k:v for k,v in pre['source_files'].items() if k.startswith('src/')}
for name,pin in source_pins.items():assert sha(root/name)==pin,name
inputs={record_path:sha(record_path),prior/'preflight-v2.json':sha(prior/'preflight-v2.json')}
for p in (folder/'summary.json',folder/'foam.json',Path(__file__),root/'tests/diagnostics/s11_foam_support_geometry.py'):
 inputs[p]=sha(p)
assert sha(folder/'foam.json')==load(folder/'summary.json')['outputs']['foam.json']
image=root/'docs/50-diagnostics/s11/2026-10-09-local-xy-foam-front-review.png'
assert sha(image)==record['review_artifact']['image_sha256'];inputs[image]=sha(image)
metadata=load(folder/'foam.json');cases=[]
# Fixed reviewed three frames plus the already-recorded intervening upper-edge control.
for f in (1620,1635,1665,1680):
 diag=metadata[f//15];assert not diag['truncated']
 directory=next(folder.glob(f'oil-debug*/frames/*/f{f:09d}_*'))
 paths=[directory/'foam_component_labels_89feab4d.png',directory/'effective_mask_93e2b9b8.png']
 for p in paths:inputs[p]=sha(p)
 labels=cv2.imread(str(paths[0]),cv2.IMREAD_UNCHANGED)
 visible=cv2.imread(str(paths[1]),cv2.IMREAD_UNCHANGED)>0
 assert labels.dtype==np.uint16 and labels.shape==(104,104)
 comps=diag['components'];assert len(comps)==diag['component_count']==diag['retained_count']
 stats=np.zeros((len(comps)+1,5),np.int32)
 for c in comps:
  ident=c['diagnostic_id'];y,x=np.where(labels==ident)
  box=[int(x.min()),int(y.min()),int(x.max()+1),int(y.max()+1)]
  assert len(x)==c['pixel_count'] and box==c['local_bbox_xyxy']
  stats[ident]=[box[0],box[1],box[2]-box[0],box[3]-box[1],len(x)]
 boxes=owner._structural_support_boxes(labels,stats,visible)
 for c in comps:
  actual=owner._structural_substrate_relation(c['diagnostic_id'],stats,boxes,104)
  assert actual==(c['predicates']['structural_substrate_present'],c['predicates']['front_from_lower_edge'])
 selected=next(c for c in comps if c['selected_component'])
 pairs=[];bound=max(3,round(104*.12))
 for rid,*_ in boxes:
  if rid==selected['diagnostic_id']:continue
  g=measure(labels,visible,selected['diagnostic_id'],rid,origin=(543,798))
  g['columns_with_visible_below_gap_within_existing_bound']=sum(r['below_corridor_fully_visible'] is True and r['below_gap_px']<=bound for r in g['columns'])
  pairs.append(g)
 cases.append(dict(frame_index=f,time_sec=f/30,component_count=len(comps),selected=selected,
       computed_structural_boxes_local_inclusive=boxes,pairs=pairs,existing_gap_bound=bound,
       all_recorded_component_predicates_reproduced=True,
       physical_role_at_displayed_guide='internal_foam_texture' if f!=1635 else 'UNREVIEWED'))
for p,pin in inputs.items():assert sha(p)==pin,p
for name,pin in source_pins.items():assert sha(root/name)==pin,name
result=dict(schema='s11-foam-texture-reply-audit-v1',status='SAVED_GEOMETRY_REPRODUCED',
    inputs={str(p.relative_to(root)):h for p,h in inputs.items()},source_pins=source_pins,
    source_head='5d9788abf2113583ee8fe0b906711469a4c2e518',inputs_preserved=True,
    video_read=False,detector_rerun=False,labels_modified=False,policy_changed=False,auto_acceptance=False,
    cases=cases,script=Path(__file__).read_text())
assert not (out/'audit.json').exists();(out/'audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
for c in cases:
 print(c['time_sec'],'s','components',c['component_count'],'selected',c['selected']['diagnostic_id'],
       'front',c['selected']['source_front_y'],'lower',c['selected']['predicates']['front_from_lower_edge'])
 for p in c['pairs']:print(' reference',p['reference_id'],'bbox_gap',p['bbox_below_gap_px'],'overlap',p['bbox_x_overlap_px'],
       'actual gap range',p['visible_below_gap_min'],p['visible_below_gap_max'],'columns within bound',p['columns_with_visible_below_gap_within_existing_bound'])
print('Preserved',len(inputs),'inputs;',len(source_pins),'source pins; no behavior change')
